summary.name: Anthropic
summary.one_liner: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company and public benefit corporation that builds the Claude family of AI models and products.
summary.what_it_does: The homepage presents Anthropic as an AI research and products company focused on safety, organized as a public benefit corporation. It announces three Claude models: Haiku 5.5, described as its fastest and most capable small model for high-volume work like summarization, subagents, and browser use; Sonnet 5.5, described as an upgrade over Sonnet 5 that runs 30%+ faster and costs up to 30% less for most work; and Opus 5.5, described as leading in agentic coding and knowledge work and costing 40% less to run than Opus 5 on typical workloads. It also links to a 2026 Public Benefit Report. Listings on other sites point to Anthropic's "Building Effective Agents" write-up, which covers agent patterns such as prompt chaining, routing, orchestrator-workers, and evaluator-optimizer.
notable: Public benefit corporation that must balance shareholder interests with public benefit
Claude Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Opus 5.5 model announcements with stated speed and cost changes
Building Effective Agents write-up on agent patterns (listed externally)
caveats: Pricing details for the Claude models are not given on the page; cost claims are relative to earlier models only.
The page is mostly marketing and announcements, with few concrete technical specifications.
